content: {"like":["Enjoys heartfelt family dramas with strong female leads (e.g., Grace & Frankie).","Prefers shows with detailed, revisitable plots (e.g., Sisters).","Values emotionally resonant, multi‑layered narratives (e.g., A Season in Purgatory).","Appreciates films that reward repeated viewings (e.g., The Shack).","Enjoys series featuring iconic actors in collaborative roles (e.g., Evening)."],"dislike":["Dislikes missing key episodes or story arcs in serialized dramas (e.g., In The Heat of the Night).","Criticizes films that lack depth or full storytelling (e.g., Heaven Is for Real).","Finds packaging and physical media issues frustrating (e.g., 4 Film Favorites).","Dislikes abrupt tonal shifts or less humor in sitcoms (e.g., Mad About You).","Rejects portrayals of male actors in roles they find unconvincing (e.g., Grace & Frankie)."]}
